mapper.select: SELECT p.po_id AS poId, p.po_no AS poNo, p.branch_code AS branchCode, b.name AS branchName, DATE_FORMAT(p.request_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS requestDate, p.status AS status, p.reject_reason AS rejectReason, p.total_material_cnt AS totalMaterialCnt, p.total_amount AS totalAmount, COALESCE(CAST(SUM(pod.requested_qty) AS SIGNED), 0) AS totalRequestedQty FROM place_order p JOIN branch b ON b.branch_code = p.branch_code LEFT JOIN place_order_detail pod ON pod.po_id = p.po_id WHERE p.status = 'PENDING' GROUP BY p.po_id, p.po_no, p.branch_code, b.name, p.request_date, p.status, p.reject_reason, p.total_material_cnt, p.total_amount ORDER BY p.request_date DESC, p.po_id DESC

SELECT p.po_id AS poId, p.po_no AS poNo, p.branch_code AS branchCode, b.name AS branchName, DATE_FORMAT(p.request_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS requestDate, p.status AS status, p.reject_reason AS rejectReason, p.total_material_cnt AS totalMaterialCnt, p.total_amount AS totalAmount, COALESCE(CAST(SUM(pod.requested_qty) AS SIGNED), 0) AS totalRequestedQty FROM place_order p JOIN branch b ON b.branch_code = p.branch_code LEFT JOIN place_order_detail pod ON pod.po_id = p.po_id WHERE p.po_no = #{value} GROUP BY p.po_id, p.po_no, p.branch_code, b.name, p.request_date, p.status, p.reject_reason, p.total_material_cnt, p.total_amount LIMIT 1

SELECT pod.po_detail_id AS poDetailId, pod.po_id AS poId, pod.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, m.unit AS unit, CAST(pod.requested_qty AS SIGNED) AS requestedQty, CAST(COALESCE(pod.approved_qty, 0) AS SIGNED) AS approvedQty, CAST(COALESCE(pod.remaining_qty, 0) AS SIGNED) AS remainingQty, COALESCE(CAST(bs.sum_qty AS SIGNED), 0) AS currentBranchStock, COALESCE(CAST(bmss.safe_stock_qty AS SIGNED), 0) AS safeStockQty, COALESCE(CAST(ws.qty AS SIGNED), 0) AS warehouseStockQty FROM place_order p
JOIN place_order_detail pod ON pod.po_id = p.po_id
JOIN material m ON m.material_code = pod.material_code
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT branch_code, material_code, SUM(current_qty) AS sum_qty FROM branch_stock GROUP BY branch_code, material_code ) bs ON bs.branch_code = p.branch_code AND bs.material_code = pod.material_code
LEFT JOIN branch_material_safety_stock bmss ON bmss.branch_code = p.branch_code AND bmss.material_code = pod.material_code
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT material_code, SUM(qty) AS qty FROM warehouse_stock WHERE status = 'AVAILABLE' GROUP BY material_code ) ws ON ws.material_code = pod.material_code
WHERE p.po_no = #{value} ORDER BY pod.po_detail_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE place_order_detail SET approved_qty = #{approvedQty}, remaining_qty = CASE WHEN requested_qty - #{approvedQty} < 0 THEN 0 ELSE requested_qty - #{approvedQty} END WHERE po_detail_id = #{poDetailId}
UPDATE place_order SET status = 'APPROVED', reject_reason = NULL WHERE po_no = #{value} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT stock_no, qty, expiry_date FROM warehouse_stock WHERE material_code = #{value} AND status = 'AVAILABLE' AND qty > 0 ORDER BY expiry_date ASC, received_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE warehouse_stock SET status = 'OUT_OF_STOCK' WHERE stock_no = #{value} AND qty = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hq_outbound ( po_no, branch_code, status, handler, shipped_at ) VALUES ( #{poNo}, #{branchCode}, 'PENDING', NULL, NOW() )
